approach: Add a code_health module in athena-core. Pure functions measure files with syn: production lines (file lines minus #[cfg(test)] module spans), longest function, 7-day churn from first-parent git log, failure citations from Records, and suite time. A threshold function yields breaches. Athena::code_health_after_landing(ui) queues one deduplicated structural-pass request per breached file through Athena::queue. It counts landings since a new typed baseline record (AnyRecord::CodeHealthBaseline, athena.code-health-baseline/1). The first landing writes the baseline with no review. The 10th landing after it queues a self-contained high-priority design review and writes a new baseline. The hook runs in Athena::land_pr after resync_onto_merge and the Pages watch, and in note_finished in steward.rs ahead of the nested-run/non-landed early return. It only logs warnings on error. StatusView gains a code-health table that display.rs renders with aligned columns. Tests set the disk minimum to 0.

steps: Check workspace Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock; add syn (full) and proc-macro2 span-locations to athena-core.
Add CodeHealthBaseline record and AnyRecord variant with round-trip test in records.rs.
Add code_health_baselines to Records in store.rs.
Write code_health.rs with measurement, thresholds, citations, queue logic, cadence, and tests.
Wire hooks in land_pr and note_finished.
Add StatusView field, fill in Athena::status, render in display.rs.
Write hook integration tests with min_free_gb 0.
Run fmt, clippy, test and fix fallout.

risks.risk: Hook in land_pr breaks existing gh tests.
risks.mitigation: Hook only warns on error and skips when no Rust sources parse.

risks.risk: Real repo breaches on first run, queuing many requests.
risks.mitigation: Intended; dedupe keeps one per file; tests use fixture trees.

risks.risk: New AnyRecord variant breaks exhaustive matches.
risks.mitigation: Fix every match the compiler reports.

risks.risk: Nested-run tests hit the disk guard.

risks.mitigation: Check xtask policy tests; syn is already in the lock via derive crates.

demonstrations.method: Unit test with fixture tree (cfg(test) mod, long and short fn), dated git landings, fixture failed/rejected records.
demonstrations.observes: Production lines exclude test module, longest fn, 7-day landings and citations equal known values.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without syn spans, test-module lines are counted and longest function is wrong; without churn/citation code the counts differ.

demonstrations.method: Threshold tests: 2001-line file, 201-line fn, 1501 lines with 5 landings, plus under-limit and boundary files.
demonstrations.observes: Each breach reported with reason; small and boundary files not flagged.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without thresholds nothing is reported or the small file is flagged.

demonstrations.method: Scratch repo; run check, read Records, rerun, then with open request.
demonstrations.observes: Exactly one request citing numbers; rerun and open-request cases queue none.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without dedupe a second request is queued; without queuing none exists.

demonstrations.method: Round-trip test in records.rs; core test writes baseline on first landing then Records::load from git into fresh StateDir.
demonstrations.observes: Record parses with right path and schema; baseline survives reload; no review on first landing.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the variant the baseline fails to parse/reload; without first-landing logic a review fires.

demonstrations.method: Set baseline, add 9 landings and check, then a 10th; min_free_gb 0.
demonstrations.observes: No review after 9; one high-priority request after 10th; none again right after.
demonstrations.fails_without: Off-by-one cadence queues on 9th or misses 10th.

demonstrations.method: Read queued review text from Records and assert phrases.
demonstrations.observes: Names code-health table, most changed and most broken files, open structural-pass requests, recent rejections and planning stops, and a short design note with proposed changes as a design-only job.
demonstrations.fails_without: Missing any phrase fails the assertions.

demonstrations.method: Integration tests in code_health_hooks.rs and gh.rs unit test land via land_pr (fake runner) and note_finished with min_free_gb 0; assert queued request and ordering after resync and Pages watch.
demonstrations.observes: Both paths queue the request for a breaching file.
demonstrations.fails_without: Removing either hook leaves no queued request, failing that test.

demonstrations.method: Render test builds StatusView with rows and suite time, calls status().
demonstrations.observes: Table has file, lines, longest fn, week, cited, limits, over columns and suite time; columns align.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the table the header assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: Run the three checks on the finished change.
demonstrations.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
demonstrations.observes: All three exit 0, including every new test and the new AnyRecord variant handled in all exhaustive matches.
demonstrations.fails_without: A formatting slip, a clippy warning, an unhandled enum variant, a missing Cargo.lock update, or any failing new test makes the chain exit non-zero.

demonstrations.observes: Unreleased entry; decision with thresholds 2000/200/1500 with 5 per week, syn call, baseline record, 10-landing cadence.
